en: He is neither born nor dead; he has no form, nor is he possessed of form.
Neither in saṃsāra nor in nirvāṇa; therefore, no agent is indicated by him. || 1 ||
It eternally destroys delusion and bestows the bliss of liberation;
it deludes all the Māras, and therefore it is indicated by the syllable "Mo. (2)

The letter *bu* indicates the exultant meditation of the Buddhas, the assembly of the Buddhas, and the perfectly awakened one who is free from afflictions; therefore, it is signified by the syllable *bu*. (3)
That which is the nature of the realm of phenomena (dharmadhātu) is always maintained by the Bodhisattvas;
it is the supreme reality among all phenomena, and thus it is indicated by the letter *dha*.
As it does not exist, so it does not exist; as it does not exist, so it exists. He who acts according to his word is indicated by the letter Ya. (5)
This five-syllabled [mantra] is meritorious, purifying, and a destroyer of sins;
those who recite it day and night attain the supreme goal.
The Śrī Pañcākṣara Stotra is complete.
